summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Gotham 1000 Value ETF (GVLU) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF consisting of large- and mid-cap value stocks from the United States. GVLU was launched on Jun 7, 2022 and is issued by Tidal.

holdings.infoBox: GVLU is an equity ETF with a total of 474 individual holdings. The top holdings are DuPont de Nemours stock at 0.51%, Aptiv at 0.51%, Hecla Mining Company at 0.50%, Stanley Black & Decker at 0.50%, and Newmont at 0.50%.
